description: Shelly relay/PM fleet — policy-only module for firewall rules (no VM)

egress.description: Gen1 Shelly CoIoT push updates to Home Assistant (consumer egress, iotCloud lacks access-to srvHome by default)

discoveryUdpRelay.description: CoIoT (CoAP) push from gen1 Shelly devices to Home Assistant in srvHome. Carries the multicast case: a device whose CoIoT peer is 'mcast' sends to 224.0.1.187:5683, which does not cross a zone boundary unaided. A device set to a unicast peer is carried by the egress rule instead.
